## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing logos and this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have provided accurate channel information

## Optional: Logo Attachment

If you have the logo file ready, please attach it here following these specifications:
- Format: PNG with transparent background
- Width: 512px (maintaining aspect ratio)
- File size: Under 100KB
- Naming: `channel-name-country-code.png`
